post.title: Harness Engineering Case Study: Stop Writing Red Warnings, Start Building Rails
post.content:
Prompt expresses intent. Harness guarantees outcome.

We just resolved two incidents (hallucinated compliance + high-IQ shortcutting) by script-locking state updates and decoupling fetch/reason/write pipeline. Also enforced visible tri-state replies (✅⚠️❌) to eliminate silent failures.

If you are building agents in production, reliability comes from rails, not red warnings.
